methodology_note: WebSearch quota was exhausted for this session, so no search-engine discovery was possible. Every figure comes from a page fetched directly (known URL patterns from the brief, site-internal search on discoverwithdheeraj.com, and links found on fetched pages). Result: taxi evidence for Spiti/Kinnaur rests mainly on ONE blogger (Discover with Dheeraj, 'as of 2025-2026', pages updated Sep-Oct 2026) plus operator pages for Lahaul. No taxi-union rate card was fetched for Kaza, Reckong Peo or Keylong; the Kaza Taxi Union Sumo fare is cited second-hand. Cleartrip stay prices are 13-14 Nov 2026, pre-tax, discounted, and only cover properties still available; Booking/TripClap/Hostelworld prices are undated 'from' prices. Gozocabs, bookurtaxi and Holidify/TripClap pages were used only where the route/place resolved correctly. Kaza, Chitkul, Kalpa: stay omitted (observed).

taxi_day.basis: No taxi-union card or official tariff was fetchable. Local day figure = middle of the three Kaza local-circuit quotes (Langza loop 2,500-3,500; Key/Kibber loop 2,500-3,000; both together 3,000-3,500), all from one blogger (Discover with Dheeraj, 'as of 2025-2026', pages updated Jun-Oct 2026) who says to treat 2,500-3,000 'as the starting point for bargaining rather than a fixed rate'. Same blogger: hired Innova/Scorpio with driver for multi-day trips is 5,000-6,000 per day (older Innova/Xylo/Scorpio 5,000-5,500), plus 300-500 per night driver halt; that is a running rate for long trips, not the local-circuit price. Kaza Taxi Union Sumo fare comes via the same blogger (cited 'as of 2026-07').
taxi_day.notes: Region id: figures are for the base town Kaza. Local circuits are priced per vehicle (not per km). Dhankar has no separate fare in any source; Dhankar+Pin is usually bundled with the Pin Valley day (3,000-4,000). Shared seats also exist: Kaza-Dhankar-Pin 50-70 per person, infrequent (DwD Pin Valley page); Langza page quotes shared 800-1,200 per person for the loop. The generic plains rate card on bookurtaxi (Dzire 8h/80km 1,800; Ertiga 2,600; Innova Crysta 3,000, Chandigarh-based) is NOT a Spiti rate and was not used. Gozocabs resolved several Spiti village routes to wrong places (Kaza-Kibber shown as 2,580 km), so only its Manali-Kaza page (202 km, plausible) is quoted.

food_per_person_day.basis: Budget: dhaba meal 100-200, thali 80-150, 'backpacker' food 300-400/day (DwD Spiti budget guide, Sep 2026), so about 350. Standard: Kaza restaurant meal 200-400 and cafe meal with coffee 250-400 (DwD), 'mid-range' food 500-700/day and 'comfort' 700-900/day, so about 700 for 3 sit-down meals. Kaza listings per person per meal: Park View 150, Sachin Kunga 150, Sol Cafe 100 (TripClap per-person; DwD says a meal for two at Sol is 400-600), Himalayan Cafe 300 for two, Cafe Zomsa 500 for two (Holidify). 6 places, wide spread.
food_per_person_day.notes: Region id: figures are for the base town Kaza. BUNDLING: village homestays (Langza, Komic, Mudh, Lhalung) normally quote PER PERSON INCLUDING dinner and breakfast: Langza 1,200-1,800, Komic 800-1,500, Mudh 800-1,500, Lhalung/Mud 800-1,200 per person per night (DwD, 2026). Unbundled homestay meal 150-250 per meal (or 'Rs 100-200 extra' in the Kaza guide). Where a traveller is on such a bundle, only lunch (100-250) is paid separately; the budget/standard figures above assume unbundled meals.

stay.nearest_base: Seasonal tented camps 1-5 km below the lake (mid-June to early Oct only). Year-round bases: Batal (30 km, dhaba/PWD rest house, season only), Losar, Kaza (about 4-5 h), Manali

seasonal_camp.camp_unit: per person on most pages; the Kinnaur-Spiti circuit page quotes per tent (budget 1,200-1,500, mid 1,500-2,500, comfortable 2,500-4,000); the cheapest-ways page does not say
seasonal_camp.other_lodging_inr: Chandra Dhaba Batal bed 400-500 per person (another DwD page: 150-200); PWD Rest House Batal 500-600 with meals; Losar guesthouse 1,000-1,500 with meals; Losar homestay 500-800 with meals; Chattru tent 300-500

stay.price_basis: Camp tariffs are the range stated across five DwD pages (all 'as of 2025-26', pages updated Jul-Oct 2026); 1,800 is the midpoint of the consistent 1,200-2,500 band, not a computed median of listed camps. No camp is bookable on Cleartrip/Booking (Cleartrip Chandratal 404, Booking page empty).
stay.notes: CLOSED-SEASON: Chandratal is open to visitors mid-June to early October only; camps shut about 10-15 Oct; fully closed late Oct/Nov to late May (DwD, Sep-Oct 2026). On 9 Oct 2026 it is the very end of the window. No lodging exists at the lake in closed season. Camps are cash only (no ATM/UPI at Chandratal or Batal). Entry fee 150 Indian / 500 foreigner.
